history.summary: Plan completed (cross-cutting): seven phases — backup-server writes validity metadata and prunes backups only, then publishes per-stream freshness from metadata read back (DockerImages); storage chart scrape plus dev ConfigMap removal, Postgres dumps opt in at 52 h, prd overdue and dead-watcher alerts (HelmCharts); OpenBao wrapper opts in (ansible); doctrine (AnsibleSpecs). A two-push HelmCharts order puts the rules after metrics are live; verification.json has 19 criteria; committed bc4e251.

Plan is complete against slice.md and the rulings and its citations hold, but P2 stops watching any scope that has lost its credential. No ruling covers that, and it is the same moment uploads to the scope start failing, so a lost credential store or a removed credential silences both the backups and the alert. The operator must choose that trade (plus one advisory on Drive read volume).
